ev_0004.summary: Parallelogram ABCD (A bottom-left, B bottom-right, C top-right, D top-left) with extra point E above D. Lines: AB (through P), DC (through Q), AD, BC. E-D-P is one straight line (D lies on segment EP). E-Q is a straight segment. P-O-Q is one straight line (O on PQ). D-O-B is one straight line (O on DB, the diagonal). Q lies on DC between D and C. Right-angle mark at D between rays DA and DB (angle ADB ~90 deg). All strokes appear solid in the raster; no dashed endpoints identified. Curve extent: none.
